concerns.text: FR-001 (Download/Parse NCBI GEO/Zenodo) and FR-010 (LODO validation) lack complete implementation tasks. T009.1.1, T009.1.2, and T009.2 are marked `[ ]` (incomplete). The plan requires fetching real external datasets for LODO, but the ingestion logic is missing, leaving the pipeline unable to satisfy these functional requirements.

FR-012 (KEGG mapping) and SC-004 (Biological validity) depend on consuming `data/processed/mapped_data.parquet`. Task T026 ('Consume persisted KEGG mapping') is listed twice (Phase 4 and Phase 5) and remains marked `[ ]` (incomplete). No other task covers the consumption of this artifact for validation, creating a gap in the validation logic.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) mandates that results be reproducible by re-running the project. Task T041 (Update README.md with Installation/Execution sections) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). Without this documentation, the project fails the reproducibility requirement, as users cannot execute the pipeline without manual intervention or guessing.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires checksumming and recording `artifact_hashes` for all generated data. Task T007.1 ('Implement checksum verification') is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). The synthetic generator (T007) produces data, but the mandatory verification and recording step is missing, violating the constitution.

FR-010 (LODO) requires independent datasets. Task T009.3.1 ('Validation of distinct stress_vector_seeds') is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). Without this verification task, there is no guarantee that the synthetic datasets generated in T009.3 are truly independent, invalidating the LODO cross-validation results.

FR-011 (Switch metric to Pearson r for population mode) requires a metric calculation function. Task T024.1 ('Implement calculate_metric') is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). T022 and T023 (Model Training) depend on this to satisfy FR-011, but the logic to switch between R² and Pearson r is missing.

Task T026 appears twice in the document (once in Phase 4, once in Phase 5) with identical descriptions. This is a stale/duplicate entry that should be consolidated to avoid confusion and ensure accurate tracking of the single implementation task.
